results.title: RFC 5322 - Internet Message Format
results.snippet: However, the domain portion contains addressing information specified by and used in other protocols (e.g., [RFC1034], [RFC1035], [RFC1123], [RFC5321]). It is therefore incumbent upon implementations to conform to the syntax of addresses for the context in which they are used. Resnick Standards Track [Page 17] RFC 5322 Internet Message Format October 2008 addr-spec = local-part "@" domain local-part = dot-atom / quoted-string / obs-local-part domain = dot-atom / domain-literal / obs-domain domain-literal = [CFWS] "[" *([FWS] dtext) [FWS] "]" [CFWS] dtext = �3-90 / ; Printable US-ASCII �4-126 / ; characters not including obs-dtext ; "[", "]", or "\" The domain portion identifies the point to which the mail is delivered.
